tasks.description: Return the maximum of a nonempty sequence, including all-negative inputs.

files.tests.py:
from calc import maximum
assert maximum([-3, -1]) == -1
assert maximum([2, 5]) == 5

hidden_files.heldout.py:
from calc import maximum
assert maximum([-100]) == -100
assert maximum([-9, -7, -11]) == -7
assert maximum([0, 1, -5]) == 1
